## Description

Briefly describe the purpose of this change and what it solves.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Code refactoring / performance optimization

## Affected Packages

- [ ] `@vlrc-fe/components`
- [ ] `@vlrc-fe/hooks`
- [ ] `@vlrc-fe/docs`

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the styling standards of this project (Meta StyleX, zero runtime Tailwind classes).
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] I have verified with `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, and `pnpm build`.
- [ ] I have generated a changeset with `pnpm changeset` (if this PR introduces a user-facing change).
